author: Gamers Nexus
description:
Sponsor: Thermal Grizzly Duronaut on Amazon - https://geni.us/tpgcPMw
Wendell from Level1 Techs has unearthed several concerning vulnerabilities in both Netgear and TP-Link routers, in particular, exposing potential vulnerabilities that could be used as backdoors. This comes at a time of peak ID verification online, which we think isn't a mistake in its link to the recent router changes. We previously covered the router ban in the US and how it has expanded to cover more devices. Netgear was granted exemptions, but not its competitors. Wendell explores both.

Watch our video detailing the router ban: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qjesRkTFZqY
Watch Wendell's video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IfOgnDTRmnA
Watch his deeper-dive here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xfRty0k_yRs
Or read his forum post: https://forum.level1techs.com/t/netgear-nighthawk-rs700s-red-team-level1diagnostic/250614/4

The best way to support our work is through our store: https://store.gamersnexus.net/
title: "There's a Secret Backdoor in Netgear" Routers, ft. Wendell of Level1 Techs
